2607.07021.title: Learning social norms enhances compatibility in dynamic human-AI coordination
2607.07021.paper_summary: Humans continuously coordinate with others in dynamic interactions, often through implicit, hard-to-quantify social norms that act as shared tacit expectations among interacting agents. As AI agents, including large language models (LLMs), become embedded in daily life, they increasingly participate in such interactions and reshape social interaction structures. Yet they often fail to coordinate with humans in an effective, considerate, and natural manner. We hypothesize that this gap arises because existing approaches align model behavior with human demonstrations without explicitly quantifying the underlying norms that generate such behavior. We selected pedestrian-vehicle interaction as a representative dynamic interaction and developed a simplified experimental platform that captures its key interactive features. From 3,456 dynamic human interactions collected via this platform, we identified three principles underlying human social norms: outcome predictability, value alignment, and advantage awareness. Incorporating these principles into AI agents significantly improves human-AI coordination. In the closed-loop interaction task with humans, the social-norm-informed LLM achieved a nearly fourfold higher total score than the baseline strategy and outperformed human-human interactions by 43%. These findings indicate that formalizing tacit social norms into explicit, quantifiable principles can enable AI agents to achieve mutually beneficial coordination in dynamic interactions, supporting their more natural integration into human society.
2607.07021.paper_summary_zh: 人類在動態互動中不斷與他人協調，這通常是通過隱性的、難以量化的社會規範來實現的，這些規範充當互動代理之間的共同默契期望。隨著人工智慧代理，包括大型語言模型（LLMs），逐漸融入日常生活，它們越來越多地參與此類互動並重塑社會互動結構。然而，它們往往無法以有效、體貼和自然的方式與人類協調。我們假設這一差距的產生是因為現有的方法將模型行為與人類示範對齊，而未明確量化產生此類行為的潛在規範。我們選擇行人-車輛互動作為一個代表性的動態互動，並開發了一個簡化的實驗平台，以捕捉其關鍵互動特徵。從通過此平台收集的3,456個動態人類互動中，我們確定了三個人類社會規範的基本原則：結果可預測性、價值對齊和優勢意識。將這些原則納入人工智慧代理中顯著改善了人類與人工智慧的協調。在與人類的閉環互動任務中，基於社會規範的LLM的總分幾乎是基準策略的四倍，並且比人與人之間的互動高出43%。這些發現表明，將隱性社會規範形式化為明確的、可量化的原則，可以使人工智慧代理在動態互動中實現互利的協調，支持它們更自然地融入人類社會。
